Annotate pairwise DNA differences with anchored sequence detail

Source: R/geom-alignseq.R
geom_alignseq.Rd

geom_alignseq() draws data prepared by alignseq_data() on annotation panels. In marker mode, all nonmatching events in the selected regions are drawn; contiguous indels have one marker, labelled with their length. Only explicitly selected details windows receive DNA callouts on their respective annotation panels. Nearby windows are merged by the preparation helper.

Usage

geom_alignseq(
  data,
  mapping = NULL,
  mode = c("markers", "rows"),
  size = 2.5,
  family = "mono",
  background = TRUE,
  max_columns = 60,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A table returned by alignseq_data(). Must be supplied explicitly. Optional boundary_after (logical) and boundary_label (character) columns mark verified boundaries, such as splice donors, after selected bases in the equally spaced sequence detail. These do not alter the DNA strings.

mapping

Optional aesthetic overrides. Prepared metadata and x/y/track are mapped automatically. Use anchor track names matching the annotation facet, never a link-panel track.

mode

"markers" (default) or "rows". Rows display all selected columns as an equally spaced DNA row in each sequence's own annotation panel, connected to its genomic extent. Row mode requires one contiguous alignment-column selection per sequence.

size

DNA character size in mm.

family

Character font, default "mono".

background

Logical; draw pale nucleotide backgrounds.

max_columns

Maximum columns in a callout or row view (default 60). Longer windows raise an error requesting a narrower selection.

na.rm, show.legend, ...

Standard layer arguments. Event colours and shapes are fixed: substitution blue circle, insertion orange triangle, deletion purple inverted triangle, ambiguous grey cross. No fill scale is added, so existing exon and link palettes remain available.

Value

A ggplot2 layer using a native annotation geom. Cartesian coordinates are required. In ggexon, use with annotation data and facet_genomics().

Details

Smooth curved connectors retain their exact genomic and callout endpoints. Marker and connector anchors follow scale_x_ggexon_genomic() automatically. Callout columns are equally spaced in panel space after genomic scaling: they are schematic alignment detail, not an additional genomic ruler. Each panel displays only its own sequence in the supplied orientation. Markers describe the query relative to the reference, not evolutionary change.

See also

alignseq_data(), geom_exon2(), scale_x_ggexon_genomic()
